content.text: Secarang > Success page; Secarang > Success page > Receipt; Secarang > CIBO > Transaction Management > Transaction Details

(Receipt No = 26110421300001, Vehicle No = JLX8382, Ref. No = BR6N006388, bought 04-11-2026 on the Allianz real UAT API; first seen 29-10-2026 on 13 Allianz receipts, e.g. Ref. No BR60006349 / Vehicle No HXA0011A / Receipt No 26102921300027)
Every Allianz purchase since this change shows the wrong amount after payment, while the Confirmation page is right. Tokio Marine and RHB receipts add up.
1. Secarang: Confirmation vs Success page and receipt
On Secarang Home (staging/ia), get quotations for a car and choose Allianz.
On Add-ons keep the default and click Continue.
Pay by FPX. On the Success page look at "Premium After NCD", then click [Receipt] and look at "Premium after NCD".
Basic Premium RM551.12, NCD 38.33% -RM211.24, All Drivers RM20.00, then
on the Success page and on the receipt PDF.
: the lines above add up to RM359.88. RM20.00 is the All Drivers amount, counted twice. Gross Premium (RM359.88) and Total Premium (RM398.65) are right.
Same on all 13 Allianz receipts of 29-10-2026 (e.g. RM882.16 instead of RM862.16) and in the e-receipt email. See screenshot 1 below.
(Basic Premium - NCD + All Drivers), the same as on Confirmation for this purchase. See screenshot 3 below.
Tokio Marine and RHB receipts already add up this way. Per SRD v1.1, Section 2.1.3a (the full Allianz journey, including the receipt). See screenshot 4 below.
In CIBO, go to Transaction Management.
Search Ref. No BR6N006388 and open Transaction Details.
on Transaction Details. See screenshot 2 below.
The CIBO receipt PDF of BR60006349 (29-10-2026) shows RM882.16 instead of RM862.16.
BR55004010 (paid 04-05-2025) shows RM862.16, which adds up, on this build. Only purchases made after this change are wrong.

on 29-10-2026, during an Allianz purchase before the Payment page, the console showed the error below. The 04-11-2026 run on the real API showed a 400 response and "ERROR Error: [object Object]" on the Add-ons page instead.
